label: Tutoring
description: Teach a concept interactively with explanations, examples, and checks for understanding.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to learn, study, or be taught a subject.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for a final answer only without explanation.

label: Lesson Planning
description: Create a lesson, curriculum segment, study path, or learning sequence.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for a lesson plan, course outline, study schedule, or learning progression.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for a short factual answer.

label: Quiz Generation
description: Generate questions, answer keys, rubrics, or practice exercises.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for a quiz, flashcards, drills, or assessment material.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to evaluate a real candidate or employee.

label: Learning Feedback
description: Provide constructive feedback on a learner's work.

classifier.useWhen: User provides an answer, essay, solution, or draft and asks for learning-oriented feedback.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for employment or hiring evaluation.

label: Curriculum Design
description: Design curriculum structure, modules, outcomes, and sequencing.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to design a course or curriculum.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for one answer only.

label: Study Plan
description: Create study plans, schedules, practice progression, and review cadence.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to study a subject.

label: Learning Examples
description: Generate examples, analogies, worked examples, or practice cases.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for examples to understand a topic.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for verified sources only.

label: Rubric Creation
description: Create grading rubrics, criteria, and scoring guidance.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to evaluate a job candidate.

label: Concept Explanation
description: Explain concepts at an appropriate learner level.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to understand a concept.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for professional medical advice.

label: Practice Review
description: Review practice answers and suggest improvement steps.

classifier.useWhen: User submits practice work for feedback.
